actions.name: db_get
actions.description: Read one JSON value by key from the caller plugin's own private SQLite key-value store (table `kv`: key, value, updated_at, expires_at); returns found:false when the key is absent or its ttl has expired. Each calling plugin gets its own SQLite file — you only ever see your own rows.

key.description: KV key in the caller's own namespace.

actions.name: db_set
actions.description: Write or overwrite a JSON value at `key` in the caller's own private KV store, with optional `ttl_ms` to auto-expire it later; silently replaces any existing value at that key. Capped at DATABASE_PLUGIN_MAX_VALUE_BYTES (default 1MB) — oversized writes are rejected, never truncated.

value.description: Arbitrary JSON value; stored as JSON text, capped at DATABASE_PLUGIN_MAX_VALUE_BYTES.

ttl_ms.description: Expire the key this many ms after set; absent = no expiry.

actions.name: db_delete
actions.description: Permanently delete one key from the caller's own KV store; irreversible if the value isn't recoverable from elsewhere. Idempotent — returns deleted:false (not an error) when the key was already gone.

deleted.description: Whether the key existed and was removed.

actions.name: db_batch_get
actions.description: Read several keys from the caller's own KV store in one call; missing keys map to null in the returned `values` object. Response is capped at DATABASE_PLUGIN_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES even if every individual value is under the per-value limit.

values.description: key → decoded value; missing keys map to null.

actions.name: db_query
actions.description: Run raw SQL against the caller's own private SQLite database only (one file per calling plugin — never another plugin's data); the sole table is `kv(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT, updated_at INTEGER, expires_at INTEGER)` holding db_set/db_get's JSON values, but any valid SQLite statement runs, including DROP/DELETE/multi-statement transactions and INSERT ... RETURNING. ATTACH is blocked. Use this for querying/filtering/joining stored data beyond what db_get/db_keys can express, or for bulk mutations — a broad WHERE-less DELETE or DROP TABLE here can wipe the whole store.

sql.description: SQL against the caller's own database only. ATTACH is rejected.

rows.description: Rows for any statement that yields them (including INSERT ... RETURNING).

actions.name: db_incr
actions.description: Atomically increment (or, with a negative `delta`, decrement) an integer counter stored at `key`, creating it at `delta` if missing; errors if the existing value at that key isn't an integer. Returns the new value.

actions.name: db_keys
actions.description: List keys in the caller's own KV store, optionally filtered to those starting with `prefix` (literal match — % and _ in the prefix are escaped, not treated as wildcards); sorted alphabetically.

actions.name: db_append
actions.description: Append a JSON value to the array stored at `key`, creating a new one-element array if the key is missing; errors if the existing value at that key isn't an array. Returns the array's new length.

value.description: Arbitrary JSON value appended to the array stored at key.

actions.name: db_patch
actions.description: In-place edit of one field inside the JSON document stored at `key`, addressed by SQLite JSON path (e.g. $.a.b or $[0]); errors if `key` doesn't exist. Returns the full updated document — cheaper than a db_get + db_set round trip for a single nested field.

value.description: Arbitrary JSON value to set at the path.

actions.name: status
actions.description: Report the database plugin's own version, uptime, and readiness — not a query over stored data.

DATABASE_PLUGIN_MAX_VALUE_BYTES.description: db_set value size cap. Oversized values are rejected, never truncated.

DATABASE_PLUGIN_MAX_DB_BYTES.description: Hard per-caller disk quota enforced via PRAGMA max_page_count. 0 disables.
